decisions.body_excerpt: About 7 months ago, I launched a website with 50,000 statistics. Every one of them was fake. ChatGPT hasn't deindexed it — 10,000+ AI sessions, 330 referring domains including Shopify, Bluehost, DHL. Made-up numbers ended up in an academic paper and a bank's investment research.
